findings: Replacement addresses previously demonstrated missing selected_rows and absent admission/body pin comparisons through explicit null/type checks.

Archive-purpose classification is used to filter rows before per-archive checks. With internally consistent manifest hashes, missing or changed purpose yields financial_archives0/admission_link_errors0/batch_shape_errors0 despite one expected archive. Read-only SELECT counterexamples reproduced this gap; production rows are unchanged.

The query remains a bounded diagnostic report, not an acceptance predicate. A future native gate must pin expected archive/member inventory and reject missing/misclassified/extra members and null aggregate pins; zero returned error counts alone cannot support PASS.

Snapshot assertions statically inspected; pin/hash/count/link checks are limited structural evidence. Source/transform/exception/repair and full consumer qualification remain absent. Existing14predicate tests reused, not rerun or described as complete native tests.
Known fractional malformed-input22P02 behavior remains; native error handling must retain a precise failure/repair state, never promote exception to PASS.

actual_readonly_counterexamples.name: original
actual_readonly_counterexamples.sql:
WITH original AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT publication_id,manifest FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_publication WHERE publication_id='2b8ffccd-a87a-4450-8c8a-5cfed318e1e4'), mutant AS(SELECT publication_id,manifest manifest FROM original),pubs AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT publication_id,manifest,encode(sha256(convert_to(manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex') manifest_sha256 FROM mutant),
a AS(SELECT p.publication_id,p.manifest,p.manifest_sha256,s.document_key admission_document_key,s.manifest_sha256 admission_sha,s.manifest->>'body_sha256' body_sha FROM pubs p LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_admission_v1 s ON s.document_key=p.manifest->>'document_key' WHERE p.manifest->>'publication_purpose'='DECODED_FINANCIAL_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_ONLY'),
b AS(SELECT a.*,x.n,x.rows_total,x.gaps,x.invalid_counts FROM a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
SELECT count(*) n,sum((value->>'source_rows')::bigint) rows_total,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(previous_last,0)+1) gaps,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE jsonb_typeof(value->'source_rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'selected_rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'first_ordinal') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR jsonb_typeof(value->'last_ordinal') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (value->>'source_rows')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM trunc((value->>'source_rows')::numeric) OR (value->>'selected_rows')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM trunc((value->>'selected_rows')::numeric) OR (value->>'first_ordinal')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM trunc((value->>'first_ordinal')::numeric) OR (value->>'last_ordinal')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM trunc((value->>'last_ordinal')::numeric) OR (value->>'source_rows')::bigint<=0 OR (value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint<1 OR (value->>'last_ordinal')::bigint<(value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint OR (value->>'source_rows')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM (value->>'last_ordinal')::bigint-(value->>'first_ordinal')::bigint+1 OR (value->>'selected_rows')::bigint<0 OR (value->>'selected_rows')::bigint>(value->>'source_rows')::bigint) invalid_counts
FROM(SELECT value,lag((value->>'last_ordinal')::bigint) OVER(ORDER BY ord) previous_last FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.manifest->'batches') WITH ORDINALITY t(value,ord)) y) x)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pubs) publications,(SELECT count(*) FROM pubs WHERE manifest_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) publication_hash_errors,
count(*) financial_archives,count(DISTINCT manifest->>'document_key') archived_documents,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE admission_document_key IS NULL OR admission_sha IS NULL OR body_sha IS NULL OR manifest->>'document_key' IS NULL OR manifest->>'admission_sha256' IS NULL OR manifest->>'body_sha256' IS NULL OR admission_sha IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'admission_sha256' OR body_sha IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'body_sha256') admission_link_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE rows_total IS DISTINCT FROM (manifest->>'source_fact_nodes')::bigint OR gaps>0 OR invalid_counts>0 OR n=0) batch_shape_errors,
encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(publication_id::text||':'||manifest_sha256,E'\n' ORDER BY publication_id),'UTF8')),'hex') financial_publication_pin_sha256,
false independent_numerical_acceptance FROM b;
